title: IngressSpec
description: Specification of the desired behavior of an Ingress, including the routing rules, TLS configuration, default backend, and reference to the ingress controller via the IngressClass.

ingressClassName.description: Name of the IngressClass cluster resource that selects which ingress controller handles this Ingress.

rules.description: List of host rules for HTTP traffic routing. If no rules match a request, the defaultBackend is used.
